precisionPolicy: Reference-group precision is a proxy. Linguistic precision is available only for explicitly adjudicated proposals; review coverage is reported. Residual groups require review.
intervalPolicy: Wilson 95% intervals are descriptive only; dependence/template repetition and unreviewed labels prevent population inference. No hunk-based independence or model-superiority test is assumed.
